nodes.title: 1. Internet Fundamentals
nodes.description: Learn how the internet operates, DNS servers resolution, HTTP request-response headers cycles, and web server browsers mechanics.
projectIdeas: Deploy a basic index.html static site explaining the TCP/IP stack mapping using GitHub Pages.
interviewQuestions: What is the function of a DNS server and how does it map domains to IP addresses?
Explain the differences between HTTP GET and POST requests.
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the internet-fundamentals milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
projects: Deploy a basic index.html static site explaining the TCP/IP stack mapping using GitHub Pages.

nodes.title: 2. Computer Fundamentals
nodes.description: Master operating systems processes scheduling, memory stack and heap segments layouts, thread concurrency locks, and basic networks structures.

resources.title: Memory Stack vs Heap Allocation Tutorial

projectIdeas: Write a memory allocation test program tracing stack and heap boundaries variables.
interviewQuestions: Explain stack vs heap memory layouts and how garbage collectors allocate spaces.
What is an operating system deadlock condition and how do you prevent it?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the computer-fundamentals milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
projects: Write a memory allocation test program tracing stack and heap boundaries variables.

nodes.title: 3. Standard Tools: PyTorch & More
nodes.description: Master version control with Git & GitHub and construct development environments using PyTorch, Keras, Jupyter, TensorBoard.
projectIdeas: Configure a GitHub repository with branches, push changes, and resolve a mock git merge conflict.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between git merge and git rebase?
Explain git stash command usage.
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the tools milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 3. Standard Tools: PyTorch & More Core Theories
projects: Configure a GitHub repository with branches, push changes, and resolve a mock git merge conflict.

nodes.title: 4. Target Languages: Python / R / C++ / SQL
nodes.description: Master variables types, asynchronous functions logic, control structures, and concurrency patterns in Python, R, C++, SQL.
projectIdeas: Build a terminal console validator app using Python handling variable arrays.
interviewQuestions: What are the reference types vs value types in Python?
How does asynchronous logic work in Python?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the languages milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 4. Target Languages: Python / R / C++ / SQL Core Theories
projects: Build a terminal console validator app using Python handling variable arrays.

nodes.title: 5. Core Frameworks: Scikit-Learn & NLTK & OpenCV
nodes.description: Build layouts, API endpoints routers, state managers, and view contexts using Scikit-Learn, NLTK, OpenCV.
projectIdeas: Develop an interactive dashboard UI layout mapping components using Scikit-Learn.
interviewQuestions: When does a Scikit-Learn component lifecycle trigger a re-render?
Explain how dependency injection or state management is handled in Scikit-Learn.
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the frameworks milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 5. Core Frameworks: Scikit-Learn & NLTK & OpenCV Core Theories
projects: Develop an interactive dashboard UI layout mapping components using Scikit-Learn.

nodes.title: 6. Database Systems: PostgreSQL / NoSQL stores
nodes.description: Configure schemas, database relationships, indexes constraints, query optimizations, and caching setups using PostgreSQL, NoSQL stores.
projectIdeas: Create database tables mapping models schema using PostgreSQL.
interviewQuestions: What is database indexing and how does it speed up queries?
Explain transaction ACID guarantees under concurrent loads.
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the databases milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 6. Database Systems: PostgreSQL / NoSQL stores Core Theories
projects: Create database tables mapping models schema using PostgreSQL.

nodes.title: 7. Quality & Testing: Model testing frameworks / Cross validations
nodes.description: Write automated tests suites including Unit tests, Integration checks, and End-to-End assertions using Model testing frameworks, Cross validations.
projectIdeas: Write unit tests files mapping components logic asserting edge input values.
interviewQuestions: Explain the differences between unit, integration, and E2E testing.
What is test mocking and why is it used for database layers?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the testing milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 7. Quality & Testing: Model testing frameworks / Cross validations Core Theories
projects: Write unit tests files mapping components logic asserting edge input values.

nodes.title: 8. Production Deployment: FastAPI model serving / AWS Sagemaker
nodes.description: Package deployment builds, containerize codebases, map variables, and host services on FastAPI model serving, AWS Sagemaker.
projectIdeas: Build production build folders, package configurations, and host online.
interviewQuestions: How do you manage environment configuration secrets inside production hosts?
What is a Docker container image build layers?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the deployment milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 8. Production Deployment: FastAPI model serving / AWS Sagemaker Core Theories
projects: Build production build folders, package configurations, and host online.

nodes.title: 9. Advanced Concepts
nodes.description: Master scaling paradigms, specialized integrations, security mitigations, and optimizations: Backpropagation neural matrices, Activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid), Computer Vision (CNNs), Natural Language Processing (NLP).
projectIdeas: Build a scalable micro-architecture or complex optimization script.
interviewQuestions: Explain how you would implement Backpropagation neural matrices to solve scalability bottlenecks.
What security vulnerabilities does Natural Language Processing (NLP) protect against?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the advanced-concepts milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
projects: Build a scalable micro-architecture or complex optimization script.

nodes.title: 10. Technical Interview Preparation
nodes.description: Drill algorithmic problem patterns, low-level design structures, system designs diagrams, and practice mock loops.
projectIdeas: Solve 50+ role-related challenges on practice platforms and log time tracking curves.
interviewQuestions: Explain how backpropagation computes gradients across hidden layers.
What is the difference between CNNs and RNNs and when is each used?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the interview-prep milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
projects: Solve 50+ role-related challenges on practice platforms and log time tracking curves.

nodes.title: 11. High Impact Portfolio Projects
nodes.description: Fulfill engineering requirements for target projects: Image Recognition Handwritten Classifier or Stock Pricing Forecasting algorithm. Set up deployment links and repository READMEs.
projectIdeas: Build complete deployable version of Image Recognition Handwritten Classifier with documentation.
Build complete deployable version of Stock Pricing Forecasting algorithm with documentation.
interviewQuestions: Explain the core architecture bottlenecks of your Image Recognition Handwritten Classifier project.
How does your database sharding or state caching optimize loading speeds?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the resume-projects milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
subtopics: 11. High Impact Portfolio Projects Core Theories
projects: Build complete deployable version of Image Recognition Handwritten Classifier with documentation.
Build complete deployable version of Stock Pricing Forecasting algorithm with documentation.

nodes.title: 12. Career Job Readiness
nodes.description: Verify resume match ratings, compile interview logs, execute speed mocks, configure networking references, and apply.
projectIdeas: Analyze your resume using StackMap's JD readiness scanner, scoring 85%+ Match rating.
interviewQuestions: Describe a complex technical challenge you solved and how you structured the engineering decisions.
How do you manage deadlines tradeoffs when multiple team milestones conflict?
learningObjectives: Master key capabilities of the job-readiness milestone.
Understand operational edge-cases and debugging logs.
Implement practical mock tasks utilizing official documentation.
projects: Analyze your resume using StackMap's JD readiness scanner, scoring 85%+ Match rating.
